whenToUse: Desktop style command bars of File, Edit and Account lists, with key hints and side flyouts
Formatting and insert lists for a document editor, such as Bold, Italic, Media and Link
View toggles and a single choice setting kept in the top bar, such as bookmarks or the theme

whenNotToUse.when: A single list of actions or account options opened from one button
Commands opened by right clicking a file, row or canvas, with no visible trigger
A signed in product header holding the logo, search, alerts and the user avatar

agentNotes: Give each `MenubarItem` its command through onClick, which both twins fire; Base UI never fires the Radix onSelect event
`MenubarShortcut` is a plain span that prints the chord only; register the keys in your own keydown listener
`MenubarLabel` throws on the base twin unless it sits inside a `MenubarGroup` or `MenubarRadioGroup`
